in_marathi.name: Rajanikant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajanikant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over others, a king or a ruler. Derived from 'Raja' meaning king, and 'Nikant' meaning controller, capable of ruling.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Rajanikant একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rules over others, a king or a ruler. Derived from 'Raja' meaning king, and 'Nikant' meaning controller, capable of ruling.
